import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

def task_func(
    feature_array,
    target_array,
    feature_names=["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5"],
    target_name="target",
    seed=None,
):
    feature_array = np.asarray(feature_array)
    target_array = np.asarray(target_array)

    if feature_array.ndim == 1:
        feature_array = feature_array.reshape(-1, 1)

    n_cols = feature_array.shape[1]

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    indices = np.arange(n_cols)
    rng.shuffle(indices)

    shuffled_array = feature_array[:, indices]

    if feature_names is not None and len(feature_names) == n_cols:
        shuffled_names = [feature_names[i] for i in indices]
        X = pd.DataFrame(shuffled_array, columns=shuffled_names)
    else:
        X = pd.DataFrame(shuffled_array)

    target_array = np.squeeze(target_array)
    if target_name is not None and target_array.ndim == 1:
        y = pd.Series(target_array, name=target_name)
    else:
        y = target_array

    clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=seed)
    clf.fit(X, y)

    return clf
